62319.name: Guide Drive · Re-ATK
62319.SpecificEffects:
Gains Code <skill mainSkill=62319>[Tracer Coating]</skill>.
Enables the ST's adjacent <color=#F74848>2</color>-tile area to become a valid attack zone for allied Missile Launcher and Rocket Launcher attacks.
When re-attacking, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
